keyword: when will artemis 2 land on the moon

verifications.claim: Artemis II is scheduled to fly around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "journey that will take astronauts around the moon but not land there" (R1); "beginning the journey around the moon" (R2); "perform a flyby of the moon" (R3); "fly at altitudes... above the surface of the far side of the moon, circle it" (R4); "send four astronauts around the moon" (R5); "crewed lunar flyby" (R6); "venture around the Moon" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: All references explicitly describe Artemis II as flying around the Moon without landing.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is scheduled to reach its closest proximity to the Moon on approximately April 6, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "On Monday, it will reach the moon" (R1, launch Wed April 1); "NASA expects the crew to reach the moon Monday morning" (R3); "Closest approach April 6, 2026" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm closest approach on April 6, 2026, matching launch date of April 1.

verifications.claim: Artemis II reaches its closest proximity to the Moon on flight day 6.

verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state closest proximity on flight day 6.
